scannability_legend.auto: Fully verifiable by an authenticated technical scan (registry/config/API/port check) using CCure Audit PRO's existing scan pipeline. No human step required for a pass/fail verdict.
scannability_legend.semi_auto: Partially verifiable technically (e.g. cross-checked against Asset Registry, credential/RBAC data, or an integration), but still needs a human to confirm scope/context or supply the remaining evidence.
scannability_legend.manual: Governance, process, HR, physical, or legal in nature. Cannot be technically scanned. Requires manual attestation + evidence upload (policy doc, screenshot, signed record, etc.).

controls.title: Policies for information security
controls.description: An information security policy and its supporting topic-specific policies are defined, approved by management, published, communicated to everyone they apply to, and reviewed at planned intervals or after significant change.
evidence_checklist: Approved information security policy document, showing version and approval date
Record of management approval (minutes, signature or workflow record)
Evidence the policy was communicated to staff and contractors
Record of the most recent scheduled policy review

controls.title: Information security roles and responsibilities
controls.description: Information security roles and responsibilities are defined and allocated according to the organisation's needs, so that every security duty has a named owner.
evidence_checklist: Documented security roles with named holders
Job descriptions or role charters covering security duties
Organisation chart showing security reporting lines

controls.title: Segregation of duties
controls.description: Conflicting duties and areas of responsibility are separated so that no single person can initiate, approve and conceal a change or transaction on their own.
evidence_checklist: Segregation-of-duties matrix for security-relevant tasks
Evidence that request and approval roles are held by different people
Review record for combinations that could not be separated, with compensating controls

controls.title: Management responsibilities
controls.description: Management requires all personnel to apply information security in line with the organisation's established policies and procedures.
evidence_checklist: Management directive or communication requiring policy compliance
Evidence of security expectations set during onboarding
Record of management review of security performance

controls.title: Contact with authorities
controls.description: Contact with relevant authorities — regulators, law enforcement, national CERTs — is established and maintained before it is needed.
evidence_checklist: List of relevant authorities with current contact details
Record of the most recent contact or registration
Procedure describing when and how authorities are engaged

controls.title: Contact with special interest groups
controls.description: Contact is maintained with special interest groups, security forums and professional associations, so the organisation receives early warning and shared practice.
evidence_checklist: List of security forums, ISACs or associations the organisation belongs to
Evidence of current membership or subscription
Example of intelligence received and acted upon

controls.title: Threat intelligence
controls.description: Threat intelligence is collected and analysed to produce actionable insight, and that insight is used to inform protective measures. New in the 2022 revision.
evidence_checklist: Named threat intelligence sources (commercial, open source or sector)
Recent threat intelligence report or digest
Evidence that intelligence changed a control, rule or priority

controls.title: Information security in project management
controls.description: Information security is integrated into project management, so security requirements are identified and addressed at every stage rather than retrofitted.
evidence_checklist: Project methodology showing security gates or checkpoints
Security requirements recorded for a recent project
Evidence of a security review before a project went live

controls.title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
controls.description: An inventory of information and other associated assets, including their owners, is developed and maintained. CCure's asset registry is the primary evidence source.
evidence_checklist: Current asset inventory export with named owners
Procedure for adding, updating and retiring inventory entries
Date and outcome of the most recent inventory reconciliation

controls.title: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
controls.description: Rules for the acceptable use of information and associated assets are identified, documented and implemented, and users are made aware of them.
evidence_checklist: Acceptable use policy
Record of user acknowledgement or acceptance
Evidence the policy is presented during onboarding

controls.title: Return of assets
controls.description: Personnel and other interested parties return all organisational assets in their possession on termination or change of employment or contract.
evidence_checklist: Asset return checklist used at offboarding
Completed return records for recent leavers
Reconciliation between the asset register and returned equipment

controls.title: Classification of information
controls.description: Information is classified according to its confidentiality, integrity, availability and any relevant interested-party requirements.
evidence_checklist: Information classification scheme with defined levels
Examples of classified information assets
Evidence that owners applied classification to their assets

controls.title: Labelling of information
controls.description: Procedures for labelling information are developed and implemented in line with the classification scheme, covering both physical and electronic forms.
evidence_checklist: Labelling procedure covering physical and electronic media
Screenshots or samples of applied labels
Evidence of user training on labelling

controls.title: Information transfer
controls.description: Information transfer rules, procedures and agreements are in place for all types of transfer facility, inside the organisation and with external parties.
evidence_checklist: Information transfer policy covering email, file transfer and physical media
Transfer agreements with external parties
Evidence that transfers use approved encrypted channels

controls.title: Access control
controls.description: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and associated assets are established and implemented on the basis of business and security requirements.
evidence_checklist: Access control policy stating the access model in use
Role-to-permission mapping
Evidence of least privilege being applied to a sample of accounts

controls.title: Identity management
controls.description: The full life cycle of identities is managed, from creation through change to revocation, so every identity is traceable to a responsible person.
evidence_checklist: Identity lifecycle procedure covering joiners, movers and leavers
Sample of account creation and revocation records
Evidence that shared or generic accounts are justified and controlled

controls.title: Authentication information
controls.description: Allocation and management of authentication information is controlled by a management process, including advising personnel on appropriate handling.
evidence_checklist: Password or authentication policy stating minimum requirements
Evidence of enforced policy settings on a sample of systems
Procedure for issuing and resetting credentials securely

controls.title: Access rights
controls.description: Access rights are provisioned, reviewed, modified and removed in accordance with the access control policy, and reviewed at planned intervals.
evidence_checklist: Access review procedure with defined frequency
Completed access review records with reviewer sign-off
Evidence that revocations identified by review were carried out

controls.title: Information security in supplier relationships
controls.description: Processes and procedures are defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the use of suppliers' products and services.
evidence_checklist: Supplier security policy
Supplier register with assessed risk levels
Security assessment record for a recent supplier

controls.title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
controls.description: Relevant information security requirements are established and agreed with each supplier, based on the type of relationship.
evidence_checklist: Standard security clauses used in supplier contracts
Signed agreement containing security requirements
Evidence that requirements vary with supplier risk

controls.title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
controls.description: Processes and procedures manage the information security risks associated with the ICT products and services supply chain.
evidence_checklist: ICT supply chain risk management procedure
Evidence of component or software provenance checks
Assessment of a critical ICT supplier's own supply chain

controls.title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
controls.description: The organisation regularly monitors, reviews, evaluates and manages change in suppliers' information security practice and service delivery.
evidence_checklist: Supplier performance and security review records
Evidence of monitoring against agreed security levels
Change record showing a supplier change was assessed

controls.title: Information security for use of cloud services
controls.description: Processes for acquiring, using, managing and exiting cloud services are established in accordance with the organisation's security requirements.
evidence_checklist: Cloud service register with owners and data classifications
Cloud security configuration baseline or benchmark results
Documented exit or portability plan for a critical cloud service

controls.title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
controls.description: Incident management is planned and prepared: responsibilities are defined and processes are established before an incident occurs.
evidence_checklist: Incident response plan with defined roles
Incident classification and escalation criteria
Evidence the plan has been exercised or tested

controls.title: Assessment and decision on information security events
controls.description: Information security events are assessed and a decision is made on whether each is to be categorised as an information security incident.
evidence_checklist: Documented triage criteria distinguishing events from incidents
Sample of assessed events with the resulting decision
Evidence of consistent categorisation over a review period

controls.title: Response to information security incidents
controls.description: Information security incidents are responded to in accordance with the documented procedures.
evidence_checklist: Incident records showing the response followed the plan
Timeline of a recent incident from detection to closure
Evidence of containment and recovery actions taken

controls.title: Learning from information security incidents
controls.description: Knowledge gained from information security incidents is used to strengthen and improve controls.
evidence_checklist: Post-incident review or lessons-learned record
Improvement actions raised from an incident, with owners
Evidence that at least one action changed a control

controls.title: Collection of evidence
controls.description: Procedures are established for the identification, collection, acquisition and preservation of evidence relating to information security events.
evidence_checklist: Digital evidence handling procedure
Chain-of-custody record from an investigation
Evidence that collection preserves integrity (hashing, write-blocking)

controls.title: Information security during disruption
controls.description: The organisation plans how to maintain information security at an appropriate level during disruption.
evidence_checklist: Business continuity plan addressing security during disruption
Evidence that security controls persist in fallback arrangements
Continuity exercise record

controls.title: ICT readiness for business continuity
controls.description: ICT readiness is planned, implemented, maintained and tested based on business continuity objectives and ICT continuity requirements. New in the 2022 revision.
evidence_checklist: ICT continuity plan with defined RTO and RPO
Most recent continuity or failover test report
Evidence that test findings were remediated

controls.title: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
controls.description: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements relevant to information security are identified, documented and kept up to date.
evidence_checklist: Register of applicable legal and regulatory obligations
Date of the last review of the register
Evidence of how a specific obligation is met

controls.title: Intellectual property rights
controls.description: Appropriate procedures protect intellectual property rights, including those covering proprietary software licensing.
evidence_checklist: Software licence register
Evidence of licence compliance review
Policy prohibiting unlicensed software

controls.title: Protection of records
controls.description: Records are protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorised access and unauthorised release.
evidence_checklist: Records retention schedule
Evidence of access restrictions on record stores
Evidence of integrity protection or immutability where required

controls.title: Privacy and protection of PII
controls.description: The organisation identifies and meets the requirements for preservation of privacy and protection of personally identifiable information under applicable law and contract.
evidence_checklist: Record of processing activities
Privacy notice provided to data subjects
Evidence of a completed privacy impact assessment

controls.title: Independent review of information security
controls.description: The organisation's approach to managing information security is independently reviewed at planned intervals and when significant change occurs.
evidence_checklist: Internal audit plan and schedule
Independent review or audit report
Corrective actions raised and their closure status

controls.title: Compliance with policies, rules and standards for information security
controls.description: Compliance with the organisation's own information security policy, topic-specific policies, rules and standards is regularly reviewed.
evidence_checklist: Compliance review schedule
Review findings with identified non-conformities
Evidence of remediation of non-conformities

controls.title: Documented operating procedures
controls.description: Operating procedures for information processing facilities are documented and made available to the personnel who need them.
evidence_checklist: Documented operating procedures for key systems
Evidence the procedures are accessible to operators
Record of the most recent procedure review

controls.title: Screening
controls.description: Background verification checks on candidates are carried out before employment, proportionate to business requirements, classification of information accessed and perceived risk.
evidence_checklist: Screening policy stating what checks apply to which roles
Completed screening records for recent hires
Evidence that screening depth scales with role sensitivity

controls.title: Terms and conditions of employment
controls.description: Employment contracts state the personnel's and the organisation's responsibilities for information security.
evidence_checklist: Employment contract template containing security clauses
Signed contract or acknowledgement from a sample of staff
Equivalent clauses in contractor agreements

controls.title: Information security awareness, education and training
controls.description: Personnel and relevant interested parties receive appropriate security awareness education, training and regular updates relevant to their role.
evidence_checklist: Security awareness training plan
Completion records with dates and pass rates
Evidence of role-specific training for privileged users

controls.title: Disciplinary process
controls.description: A formal and communicated disciplinary process is in place to take action against personnel who commit an information security policy violation.
evidence_checklist: Documented disciplinary process referencing security violations
Evidence the process was communicated to staff
Record of consistent application (anonymised if necessary)

controls.title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
controls.description: Information security responsibilities that remain valid after termination or change of employment are defined, enforced and communicated.
evidence_checklist: Offboarding checklist covering continuing obligations
Evidence that leavers were reminded of ongoing duties
Confirmation that access was revoked on the effective date

controls.title: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
controls.description: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements reflecting the organisation's needs are identified, documented, regularly reviewed and signed.
evidence_checklist: NDA template in current use
Signed NDAs for staff and third parties with access
Date of the last NDA template review

controls.title: Remote working
controls.description: Security measures are implemented when personnel work remotely, to protect information accessed, processed or stored outside the organisation's premises.
evidence_checklist: Remote working policy
Evidence of VPN or equivalent secure access enforcement
Endpoint protection and encryption status for remote devices

controls.title: Information security event reporting
controls.description: A mechanism exists for personnel to report observed or suspected information security events through appropriate channels in a timely manner.
evidence_checklist: Documented reporting channel and how staff are told about it
Sample of reports received
Evidence of acknowledgement and follow-up on reports

controls.title: Physical security perimeters
controls.description: Security perimeters are defined and used to protect areas that contain information and other associated assets.
evidence_checklist: Site plan showing defined security perimeters
Photographs or description of perimeter barriers
Record of perimeter inspection

controls.title: Physical entry
controls.description: Secure areas are protected by appropriate entry controls and access points, so only authorised personnel enter.
evidence_checklist: Access control system configuration for secure areas
Authorised access list with review date
Sample of entry logs

controls.title: Securing offices, rooms and facilities
controls.description: Physical security for offices, rooms and facilities is designed and implemented.
evidence_checklist: Physical security standard for offices and equipment rooms
Evidence of implemented measures (locks, screening, signage)
Record of a physical security walkthrough

controls.title: Physical security monitoring
controls.description: Premises are continuously monitored for unauthorised physical access. New in the 2022 revision.
evidence_checklist: Description of monitoring in place (CCTV, alarms, guards)
Retention period and sample of monitoring records
Procedure for responding to a monitoring alert

controls.title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
controls.description: Protection is designed and implemented against physical and environmental threats, including natural disasters and other intentional or unintentional threats.
evidence_checklist: Environmental threat assessment for each site
Evidence of protective measures (fire suppression, flood defence)
Test or inspection records for those measures

controls.title: Working in secure areas
controls.description: Security measures for working in secure areas are designed and implemented.
evidence_checklist: Rules for working in secure areas
Evidence the rules are displayed or briefed
Record of supervision or escort arrangements for visitors

controls.title: Clear desk and clear screen
controls.description: Clear desk rules for papers and removable storage media, and clear screen rules for information processing facilities, are defined and enforced.
evidence_checklist: Clear desk and clear screen policy
Evidence of enforced automatic screen lock settings
Record of a clear desk inspection

controls.title: Equipment siting and protection
controls.description: Equipment is sited securely and protected from environmental threats and unauthorised access.
evidence_checklist: Equipment siting standard
Evidence of rack or cabinet security in equipment rooms
Environmental monitoring readings for equipment areas

controls.title: Security of assets off-premises
controls.description: Assets off-premises are protected, accounting for the different risks of working outside the organisation's sites.
evidence_checklist: Policy covering assets taken off-site
Register of off-site assets with holders
Evidence of encryption and tracking on mobile devices

controls.title: Storage media
controls.description: Storage media are managed through their life cycle of acquisition, use, transportation and disposal in accordance with the classification scheme and handling requirements.
evidence_checklist: Removable media policy
Media register or control mechanism
Secure disposal certificates for retired media

controls.title: Supporting utilities
controls.description: Information processing facilities are protected from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities.
evidence_checklist: UPS and generator inventory with capacity
Most recent utility failover test record
Maintenance schedule for supporting utilities

controls.title: Cabling security
controls.description: Cables carrying power, data or supporting information services are protected from interception, interference or damage.
evidence_checklist: Cabling standard or plan
Evidence of physical protection (conduit, segregation, labelling)
Inspection record for cabling routes

controls.title: Equipment maintenance
controls.description: Equipment is maintained correctly to ensure the continued availability and integrity of information.
evidence_checklist: Maintenance schedule for critical equipment
Maintenance records showing the schedule is followed
Evidence that maintenance personnel are authorised and supervised

controls.title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
controls.description: Items of equipment containing storage media are verified to ensure any sensitive data and licensed software has been removed or securely overwritten before disposal or re-use.
evidence_checklist: Secure disposal and re-use procedure
Sanitisation or destruction certificates
Verification record confirming data removal before re-use

controls.title: User endpoint devices
controls.description: Information stored on, processed by or accessible via user endpoint devices is protected, including through endpoint hardening, disk encryption and screen locking.
evidence_checklist: Endpoint hardening baseline
Disk encryption status report across the endpoint estate
Evidence of enforced screen lock and local administrator restrictions

controls.title: Privileged access rights
controls.description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights is restricted and managed, with privileged accounts identified, justified and reviewed.
evidence_checklist: Inventory of privileged accounts with business justification
Evidence of multi-factor authentication on privileged access
Most recent privileged access review with sign-off

controls.title: Information access restriction
controls.description: Access to information and other associated assets is restricted in accordance with the established access control policy.
evidence_checklist: Permission matrix for key information stores
Evidence of restriction testing on a sample of resources
Exception register for broad access grants

controls.title: Access to source code
controls.description: Read and write access to source code, development tools and software libraries is appropriately managed.
evidence_checklist: Repository access list with roles
Branch protection or code review enforcement settings
Evidence that build systems restrict who can publish artefacts

controls.title: Secure authentication
controls.description: Secure authentication technologies and procedures are implemented, based on the access restrictions and the access control policy.
evidence_checklist: Authentication standard specifying minimum length and complexity
Evidence of enforced password policy on a sample of hosts
Multi-factor authentication coverage report

controls.title: Capacity management
controls.description: The use of resources is monitored and adjusted in line with current and expected capacity requirements.
evidence_checklist: Capacity monitoring dashboards or reports
Defined capacity thresholds and alerting
Record of a capacity-driven change

controls.title: Protection against malware
controls.description: Protection against malware is implemented and supported by appropriate user awareness.
evidence_checklist: Anti-malware coverage report across the estate
Evidence that signatures or engines are current
User awareness material covering malware

controls.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.description: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems in use is obtained, exposure evaluated, and appropriate measures taken.
evidence_checklist: Most recent vulnerability scan report
Remediation SLA by severity and evidence of adherence
Register of accepted vulnerability risks with expiry dates

controls.title: Configuration management
controls.description: Configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services and networks are established, documented, implemented, monitored and reviewed.
evidence_checklist: Documented secure configuration baselines per platform
Compliance report against those baselines
Evidence that drift is detected and corrected

controls.title: Information deletion
controls.description: Information stored in information systems, devices or any other storage media is deleted when no longer required. New in the 2022 revision.
evidence_checklist: Data retention and deletion schedule
Evidence of automated or scheduled deletion jobs
Deletion certificates or logs for a recent retention cycle

controls.title: Data masking
controls.description: Data masking is used in accordance with the access control policy and applicable legislation, to limit exposure of sensitive data. New in the 2022 revision.
evidence_checklist: Data masking or tokenisation standard
Evidence of masking in non-production environments
Sample showing masked output for a sensitive field

controls.title: Data leakage prevention
controls.description: Data leakage prevention measures are applied to systems, networks and devices that process, store or transmit sensitive information. New in the 2022 revision.
evidence_checklist: DLP policy and the channels it covers
DLP tool configuration or rule set
Sample of DLP alerts and their disposition

controls.title: Information backup
controls.description: Backup copies of information, software and systems are maintained and regularly tested in accordance with the agreed backup policy.
evidence_checklist: Backup policy stating scope, frequency and retention
Recent backup job success report
Restore test record proving backups are usable

controls.title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
controls.description: Information processing facilities are implemented with sufficient redundancy to meet availability requirements.
evidence_checklist: Architecture diagram showing redundant components
Defined availability targets
Most recent failover test result

controls.title: Logging

controls.description: Logs recording activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events are produced, stored, protected and analysed.
evidence_checklist: Logging standard listing which events are recorded
Evidence of audit policy enabled on a sample of hosts
Log retention configuration and protection from tampering

controls.title: Monitoring activities
controls.description: Networks, systems and applications are monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate actions are taken to evaluate potential incidents.
evidence_checklist: Description of monitoring coverage (EDR, IDS/IPS, SIEM)
Sample of alerts and their triage outcome
Defined thresholds for escalating an anomaly to an incident

controls.title: Clock synchronization
controls.description: Clocks of information processing systems are synchronised to approved time sources, so that log timestamps can be correlated across systems.
evidence_checklist: Approved time source list
Evidence of NTP configuration on a sample of hosts
Check that log timestamps agree across two systems

controls.title: Use of privileged utility programs

evidence_checklist: List of privileged utilities in use and who may run them
Evidence of restricted execution or approval workflow
Log sample showing utility use is recorded

controls.title: Installation of software on operational systems

Application allow-list or software inventory baseline
Evidence that unauthorised software is detected and removed

controls.title: Networks security

evidence_checklist: Network security architecture and firewall rule base
Evidence that legacy and insecure protocols are disabled
Most recent firewall rule review

controls.title: Security of network services
controls.description: Security mechanisms, service levels and service requirements of network services are identified, implemented and monitored.
evidence_checklist: Inventory of network services with their security requirements
Evidence that management and database services are not exposed
Service level agreements covering network security

controls.title: Segregation of networks

evidence_checklist: Network segmentation diagram showing zones and boundaries
VLAN or firewall configuration enforcing the segmentation
Evidence of segmentation testing between zones

controls.title: Web filtering

Web filter configuration or coverage report
Sample of blocked-request logs

controls.title: Secure development life cycle

evidence_checklist: Secure development lifecycle policy
Evidence of security activities at each development stage
Developer secure coding training records

controls.title: Application security requirements
controls.description: Information security requirements are identified, specified and approved when developing or acquiring applications.
evidence_checklist: Security requirements template for new applications
Approved requirements for a recent application
Evidence that requirements were verified before release

controls.title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
controls.description: Principles for engineering secure systems are established, documented, maintained and applied to any information system development activity.
evidence_checklist: Documented secure architecture principles
Architecture review record for a recent system
Evidence of threat modelling

controls.title: Secure coding
controls.description: Secure coding principles are applied to software development. New in the 2022 revision.
evidence_checklist: Secure coding standard in use
Static analysis or code review results
Evidence that identified coding defects were fixed

controls.title: Security testing in development and acceptance
controls.description: Security testing processes are defined and implemented in the development life cycle.
evidence_checklist: Security test plan covering the development lifecycle
Most recent penetration test or DAST report
Evidence that findings were remediated before release

controls.title: Outsourced development
controls.description: The organisation directs, monitors and reviews the activities related to outsourced system development.
evidence_checklist: Contractual security requirements for outsourced development
Evidence of code or security review of delivered work
Acceptance testing record covering security

controls.title: Separation of development, test and production environments
controls.description: Development, testing and production environments are separated and secured.
evidence_checklist: Environment topology showing separation
Evidence of distinct credentials and network boundaries per environment
Change control record for promotion between environments

controls.title: Change management
controls.description: Changes to information processing facilities and information systems are subject to change management procedures.
evidence_checklist: Change management procedure
Sample of change records with approvals
Evidence of security impact assessment within the change process

controls.title: Test information
controls.description: Test information is appropriately selected, protected and managed.
evidence_checklist: Test data management standard
Evidence that production data is masked or synthetic in test
Approval record for any use of live data in testing

controls.title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
controls.description: Audit tests and other assurance activities involving assessment of operational systems are planned and agreed between the tester and appropriate management.
evidence_checklist: Agreed audit test plan and scope
Management authorisation for testing on operational systems
Record of controls applied to limit disruption during testing
